Q5910.reason: A restriction forbidding building on a strip, tied to the utility easement in a general plan, is most naturally a negative easement, and the options only offer A or B.

Q5623.reason: The commentary concerned a newsworthy public figure and a public event and was opinion, so it is privileged and the privacy claim fails.

Q5004.reason: The class gift to the sister's children who reach 25 could vest beyond lives in being plus 21 years, so it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and the friend keeps the lot.
